description: This file implements functions for managing loose object index mapping in a Git repository, including reading, writing, and manipulating the object ID maps.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_init(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Initializes a new loose object map with hash tables for ID mappings.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a hash map, returning 1 if inserted, 0 if already exists.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts a mapping between an object ID and a compatible object ID into the loose map.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads a loose object map from a file into the repository's data structures.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Orchestrates loading of all loose object maps for the repository.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map to a file.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Appends a single object ID and its mapping to the loose object index file.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds a new mapping between object IDs to the loose map and updates the index file.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped object ID for a given source ID.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the loose object map, including ID hash tables.
